abstract: A twenty-six-year-old male patient with advanced choriocarcinoma originated from mediastinum was treated by high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) transplantation. He had massive tumors in the cervical, mediastinal and bilateral lung fields. After 3 kur of PVeBV therapy (CDDP 60 mg x day 1-3, etoposide 160 mg x day 1-3, BLM 30 mg x day 1, VBL 12 mg x day 1), he obtained complete remission. PBSC was collected at the time of hematopoietic recovery and high-dose chemotherapy with PBSC transplantation was conducted because of the high possibility of recurrence. The hematopoietic recovery was rapid, and the patient remained well with no sign of recurrence for 24 months.
abstract_ja: 進行した縦隔由来の絨毛癌を有する26歳男性に対して、末梢血幹細胞(PBSC)移植を併用した大量化学療法を施行した。頸部、縦隔、両肺野に巨大な腫瘍を認めた。PVeBV療法(CDDP 60 mg 1〜3日目、エトポシド160 mg 1〜3日目、BLM 30 mg 1日目、VBL 12 mg 1日目)を3クール施行後、完全寛解が得られた。再発の可能性が高いと判断し、造血回復時にPBSCを採取し、PBSC移植を伴う大量化学療法を実施した。造血回復は速やかであり、患者は24か月間再発の徴候なく良好な状態を保った。
